root object [resource: https://example.test/schemas/root.json]
├─ shared -> shared
├─ child -> https://example.test/schemas/parts/child.json
└─ childValue -> #/$defs/child/properties/value

Definitions
├─ shared string
└─ child object [resource: https://example.test/schemas/parts/child.json]
   ├─ value integer
   ├─ self -> https://example.test/schemas/parts/child.json [recursive]
   ├─ sharedFromParent -> shared
   └─ ownValue -> #/$defs/child/properties/value
